[[Elections in the United States|Elections]] to the [[United States House of Representatives]] were held on November 3, 2026, to elect all 1,527 members of the House. No party came close to the 764 seats needed for a majority: the Republican-aligned bloc won 682 seats, the Democratic-aligned bloc 667 and unaligned parties 178.
